title: Hotel California Nightmare
description: A surreal desert night scene featuring the illuminated Hotel California in the background with its iconic sign. A vintage silver car drives on a winding road covered in lyrics toward the hotel, where a large bonfire burns in the courtyard surrounded by dancing silhouetted figures, while ghostly apparitions and bats fill the purple sky.
prompt: Surreal desert night scene at the famous Hotel California, pink stucco building glowing under a deep purple sky, large fiery bonfire in the courtyard with silhouetted people dancing around it, vintage silver Mercedes driving on a winding road covered in song lyrics, ghostly cloaked figure on the left emitting pink smoke, bats and floating objects in the sky, bell arch with a glowing figure, dark eerie atmosphere inspired by the Eagles song
